**I guruh nogironligi bo‘lgan xodim uchun ish vaqti haftasiga 36 soatdan oshmasligi kerak, 48 soat emas.** [1]

- I va II guruh nogironligi bo‘lgan xodimlar uchun ish vaqtining davomiyligi haftasiga o‘ttiz olti soatdan oshmaydigan qilib belgilanadi. [1]
- Kunlik ish (smena) davomiyligi tibbiy-ijtimoiy ekspert komissiyasining tavsiyalariga muvofiq belgilanadi, lekin olti kunlik ish haftasida — olti soatdan, besh kunlik ish haftasida — yetti soatu o‘ttiz daqiqadan ortib ketmasligi kerak. [1]
- Ish vaqtining qisqartirilgan davomiyligi I va II guruh nogironligi bo‘lgan xodimlarga majburiy tartibda belgilanadi. [2]
- Qisqartirilgan ish vaqtida mehnatga haq to‘lash kamaytirilmasdan, to‘liq ish vaqtida ishlaydigan xodimlar uchun belgilangan miqdorda amalga oshiriladi. [2]

Agar mehnat shartnomangizda 40 soat va undan ortiq ish vaqti belgilangan bo‘lsa, ish beruvchiga yozma ariza bilan murojaat qilib, qonunda belgilangan 36 soatlik ish vaqtini talab qilishingiz mumkin. [3]

---
*Eslatma: Ushbu ma'lumot O'zbekiston Respublikasining amaldagi qonunchiligi asosida axborot va tushuntirish berish maqsadida taqdim etildi. U vakolatli davlat organlarining rasmiy qarori yoki sud hujjati o'rnini bosmaydi.*

**II guruh nogironligi bo'lgan xodimga yillik mehnat ta'tili kamida 30 kalendar kun beriladi** [1][2].

- Bu ta'tilni xodim yilning o'zi uchun qulay bo'lgan vaqtida olishi mumkin [1][3].
- II guruh nogironligi bo'lgan xodimni yillik mehnat ta'tilidan chaqirib olishga yo'l qo'yilmaydi [1].
- Ish davrida 30 kunlik uzaytirilgan asosiy ta'tilni pulli kompensatsiya bilan almashtirishga yo'l qo'yilmaydi — undan asli holida foydalanish kerak [4].
- Bundan tashqari, II guruh nogironligi bo'lgan xodimga yozma arizasi asosida ish haqi saqlanmagan holda har yili 14 kalendar kungacha qo'shimcha ta'til berilishi shart [5][6].

**Nima qilish kerak:** ta'til vaqtini o'zingizga qulay qilib belgilash uchun ish beruvchiga murojaat qiling; ish haqi saqlanmagan ta'til uchun yozma ariza topshirishingiz kerak [5].

---

**The annual leave of an employee with a Group I disability is at least 30 calendar days, not 45 days.**

Under the Labour Code of the Republic of Uzbekistan (2022), employees with Group I or Group II disabilities are entitled to annual paid leave of at least 30 calendar days [1][2].

Key points about this leave:

- **Convenient timing**: You may use this leave at a time of year that is convenient for you [1].
- **No recall**: The employer is not allowed to recall you from annual leave [1].
- **Before six months**: You can take annual leave before completing six months of work with your employer [3].
- **Proportional calculation**: If your disability is established or removed during the working year, the leave duration is calculated proportionally to the periods before and after the disability was established or removed [1].
- **Unpaid leave**: In addition, upon your written request, the employer must give you unpaid leave of up to 14 calendar days each year [4].

The figure of 45 days is not supported by the legislation. The correct minimum is 30 calendar days.
